hero.tagline: Turning ideas into interactive web experiences.

aboutMe.firstTagLine: Hi! I'm Chris! I am a passionate Fullstack developer who loves building modern, user-friendly web applications. I enjoy turning ideas into interactive experiences. I am always eager to learn new technologies.
aboutMe.pathTagLine: My path here wasn't typical: I started out as a bricklayer, working in that field for several years before moving into the industrial sector. A workplace accident led me to programming and prompted me to begin retraining—in hindsight, exactly the right next step for me.
aboutMe.hobbyTagLine: Outside of code, gaming has fascinated me since I was a kid, and I'm still into it today. Learning to program became a new chapter for me after the accident, but gaming has stayed a constant throughout.

join.description: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop, assign users and categories.

sharkie.description: 2D jump'n'run in which you swim as a shark through procedurally generated levels, fight enemies and an end boss, and collect coins. Includes menus, a shop, a sound system and touch controls for mobile devices.

pokedex.description: Interactive Pokédex web app built on the PokéAPI. All Pokémon as cards with lazy loading, search and a detail dialog with tabs for About, Base Stats, Evolution and Moves. Also includes a loading screen and navigation through the dialog.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1P1: The party responsible for data processing on this website is:
privacy.s2P1: Personal data is only processed to the extent necessary to provide this website, its content and to respond to inquiries. The legal bases are the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the German Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG).
privacy.s3P1: This website is hosted by netcup GmbH, Emmy-Noether-Str. 10, 76131 Karlsruhe, Germany. The provider processes data arising when the website is accessed on my behalf. A data processing agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR is in place with netcup. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in a secure and efficient provision of the website).
privacy.s4P1: When the website is accessed, the following information transmitted by the browser is recorded automatically: IP address of the accessing device, date and time, requested URL, HTTP status code, referrer URL, and browser and operating system information (user agent). This data serves the secure operation of the website and is not merged with other data sources. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.
privacy.s4P2: Storage period: as a rule, no longer than 14 days. Earlier deletion is possible. Longer retention only takes place in exceptional cases where this is necessary to investigate abuse or attacks.
privacy.s5P1: If you write to me by email, your details (email address, name, content of the message) are stored to process the inquiry and for follow-up questions. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures) or Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding). The data is deleted as soon as it is no longer required for its purpose and no statutory retention obligations apply.
privacy.s6P1: If you use the contact form, the data you enter is processed: name, email address and your message. The data is used exclusively to process your inquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures) or Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding). The data is sent to me by email via a PHP script on my hosting provider's server. Nothing is stored on the server; the data only resides in my email inbox. It is deleted as soon as it is no longer required for its purpose and no statutory retention obligations apply.
privacy.s7P1: This website does not use external services, cookies, analytics or tracking services.
privacy.s7P2: Fonts are loaded locally from the site's own server; no connection to Google servers is made.
privacy.s8P1: You have the following rights with regard to your personal data: access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection to processing (Art. 21). You can withdraw any consent given at any time with effect for the future. To exercise your rights, an informal message to the email address stated above is sufficient.
